please read the product description carefully so you know what you're buying!

IMPERFECT: 
Pieces marked as "Imperfect" have minor flaws such as fabric defects, stains, or sewing imperfections, as detailed in their descriptions.

SAMPLE:
Sample pieces were created during the development of our designs. They may have a slightly different fit from the final version, have been wash-tested, used in photoshoots, or feature sewing finishes of lesser quality compared to our production pieces.

PHOTO SAMPLES:
These items were selected from our ‘production pieces’ inventory and used in photoshoots. They remain in excellent condition, except for being worn on set. (I.e If they had makeup stains, they would be categorized under Imperfect.)

LAST CHANCE ITEMS:
We only discount our clothing when we have just a few pieces left of a style we won't be restocking or a fabric we can’t reorder. Enjoy these last chance finds!



Please note that all sales on this page are final, reach out to us for sizing advice!

description:
A few notes before you order ~

Céleste is a more fitted style, and since she’s brand new to our lineup, we don’t yet have many reference points when it comes to fit.

title: SS24
description:
L'envolée SS24

In French, l'envolée translates to "flying away."

This collection holds immense personal significance for me, resonating deeply across various facets of my life at this particular juncture. It signifies a departure from the safety of our Vancouver sanctuary after five years, as I embark on a journey aimed at simplifying my existence, all while grappling with the uncertainty that accompanies such a bold move.

As a woman and a mother, prioritizing my own needs often feels like an uphill battle. Yet, as both a designer and a business owner, it's a vital assertion of my self-worth.

L'envolée emerges amidst the whirlwind of operational and internal transformations. Each piece embodies not only my aesthetic preferences but also my deepest desires. Some are grounded in pragmatism, while others exude whimsy, yet all serve as a reflection of the ever-evolving nature of our lives.

Here's to embracing the discomfort of uncertainty. Though it may be challenging to recall at times, it invariably paves the way for marvelous transformations.

title: Tristan Pants
Zero Waste
description:
At harly jae, we are committed to sustainability in every step of our production process. When crafting our timeless clothing, we strive to minimize our waste and make the most of every material. This commitment has led us to create something truly special: our Zero Waste collection.

These small fabric pieces, which would typically end up in a landfill, are given new life in our ZW collection. It's one of our most exciting and rewarding projects, allowing us to transform what was once considered waste into beautiful, sustainable pieces that you can feel good about wearing.

This collection is one of the most exciting & rewarding project to work on at harly jae - we hope you enjoy it too!

title: Zero Waste Gift Shop
description:
When making our clothing, there is always a little bit of fabric that ends up unused.
We call these leftover fabrics: scraps. These small fabric pieces would typically end up in the landfill.

In the spirit of lessening our waste,
we collect our fabric scraps and give them a life of their own.

For the first time ever, enjoy the holiday edition of our
Zero Waste collection!
